Introduction
AI Translation

ESP32-C3-MINI-1 and ESP32-C3-MINI-1U are general-purpose Wi-Fi and low-power Bluetooth modules featuring a compact form factor and rich peripheral interfaces, suitable for smart home, industrial automation, healthcare, consumer electronics, and other applications.

Features
AI Translation
Integrated ESP32-C3FH4 or ESP32-C3FN4 chip, RISC-V 32-bit single-core microprocessor, up to 160MHz clock speed, 384KB ROM, 400KB SRAM, 8KB RTC SRAM, 4MB embedded flash
IEEE 802.11b/g/n, operating frequency 2412~2484MHz, 20MHz and 40MHz bandwidth, 1T1R mode, data rate up to 150Mbps, WMM, frame aggregation, immediate block ACK, fragmentation and defragmentation, TXOP, automatic Beacon monitoring, 4x virtual Wi-Fi interfaces, Station, SoftAP, Station+SoftAP, and promiscuous modes, 802.11mc FTM
Bluetooth 5 LE, Bluetooth Mesh, data rates: 125Kbps, 500Kbps, 1Mbps, 2Mbps, advertising extensions, multiple advertising, channel selection, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth coexistence
Peripherals: GPIO, SPI, UART, I2C, I2S, IR remote control, LED PWM controller, general DMA controller, TWAI controller (CAN 2.0 compatible), USB serial/JTAG controller, temperature sensor, SAR ADC, general-purpose timers, watchdog timers
40MHz integrated crystal oscillator
Antenna options: on-board PCB antenna (ESP32-C3-MINI-1) or external antenna via connector (ESP32-C3-MINI-1U)
Operating voltage 3.0~3.6V, operating temperature: -40~85°C and -40~105°C variants
Testing: HTOL, HTSL, uHAST, TCT, ESD, Latch-up
RF certification
Applications
AI Translation
Smart Home
Industrial Automation
Healthcare
Consumer Electronics
Smart Agriculture

Product FAQ
1. What voltage rating, current capacity, and wire gauge ranges govern the JST XHP-2 housing?
The JST XHP-2 wire-to-board socket housing is rated for a maximum voltage of 250V AC/DC and a continuous current capacity of up to 3A AC/DC when used with AWG #22 conductors. It accepts compatible crimp socket contacts, including the SXH-001T-P0.6 and SXH-002T-P0.6 series, supporting wire sizes from AWG #30 to #22 (0.05–0.33 mm², depending on contact type) with insulation outer diameters ranging from 0.9 mm to 1.9 mm.
Read more
2. Which pin pitch, position count, housing material, and flammability ratings define the XHP-2?
The XHP-2 features a 2.5 mm pitch in a single-row, 2-position configuration. It is molded from natural white PA6 (Nylon 6) with a UL94V-0 flammability rating. The datasheet lists the housing dimensions for the XHP-2 as A = 2.5 mm, B = 5.7 mm, and C = 7.3 mm.
Read more
3. Which PCB headers and crimp contacts pair directly with the XHP-2 housing?
The XHP-2 receptacle housing is compatible with the 2-circuit JST XH-series through-hole PCB headers, including the B2B-XH-A top-entry and S2B-XH-A side-entry headers. It accepts SXH-001T-P0.6 and SXH-002T-P0.6 crimp contacts for wire termination.
Read more
4. What operating temperature limits, insulation resistance, and dielectric specifications apply to the XHP-2 housing?
The XHP-2 is specified for an operating temperature range of −25°C to +85°C, including temperature rise during current flow. The connector system provides an initial contact resistance of 10 mΩ maximum, an insulation resistance of at least 1,000 MΩ, and a withstanding voltage of 1,000 VAC for one minute.
Read more
5. How is the XHP-2 housing used during PCB assembly?
The XHP-2 is a cable-side crimp housing and is not mounted directly to a printed circuit board. Instead, it mates with compatible 2-circuit JST XH-series through-hole PCB headers, such as the B2B-XH-A and S2B-XH-A, while the electrical connection to the wire is made using compatible SXH-series crimp contacts.
Read more

Product FAQ
1. What are the key electrical and physical specifications of the YAGEO RC0402FR-0710KL resistor?
The YAGEO RC0402FR-0710KL is a 10kΩ thick-film chip resistor with a tight ±1% tolerance, suited to stable signal-level applications such as voltage dividers and pull-up networks. It uses an 0402 (1005 metric) package, measuring about 1.0mm × 0.5mm with a low profile around 0.35mm high. It is rated 62.5mW (1/16W) and 50V, making it well suited to space-constrained, low-power PCB designs where electrical stability matters.
Read more
2. Can the YAGEO RC0402FR-0710KL be used in 3.3V and 5V logic and analog circuits?
Yes. The RC0402FR-0710KL works in 3.3V and 5V digital and analog circuits, including Arduino, ESP32, STM32, and Raspberry Pi systems, where 10kΩ is a standard pull-up/pull-down value for GPIO stabilisation. At 5V it draws only 0.5mA (5V ÷ 10kΩ) and dissipates about 2.5mW, far below its 62.5mW rating. That makes it safe for signal conditioning, ADC biasing, and logic interfacing, but not for power delivery or high-current paths.
Read more
3. How reliable is the YAGEO RC0402FR-0710KL under long-term thermal and electrical stress?
The RC0402FR-0710KL operates from −55°C to +155°C, suiting industrial-grade environments, and has a temperature coefficient of ±100ppm/°C for predictable drift. Long-term reliability depends on power derating: operation at higher ambient temperatures calls for reduced load to limit resistance drift. The thick-film construction gives stable general-purpose performance, though continuous operation near maximum power can slightly affect long-term tolerance stability.
Read more
4. What packaging format and procurement options are available for the YAGEO RC0402FR-0710KL?
The RC0402FR-0710KL is supplied on standard tape-and-reel for automated SMT assembly, with a full reel of about 10,000 pieces. Cut-tape and small quantities are widely available for prototyping and evaluation. For production, full-reel ordering is preferred to ensure stable pick-and-place feeding and consistent throughput. Availability can vary with distributor stock and regional supply.
Read more
5. What PCB layout practices should be followed when using a 0402 10kΩ resistor like the YAGEO RC0402FR-0710KL?
Use an IPC-compliant 0402 land pattern (about 1.0mm × 0.5mm footprint) to ensure good solder wetting and placement accuracy, and standard lead-free reflow profiles with peaks up to 260°C for short durations. A symmetric pad layout helps prevent uneven surface tension during reflow, which can cause tombstoning. In high-impedance circuits, place the resistor close to signal nodes to reduce noise pickup and maintain signal integrity.

Product FAQ
1. What are the primary electrical and physical specifications of the RC0603FR-07100KL resistor?
The YAGEO RC0603FR-07100KL is a 100kΩ thick film chip resistor in the 0603 (1608 metric) surface-mount package, with ±1% resistance tolerance and a 1/10W power rating at 70°C ambient. It measures 1.60mm × 0.80mm with a height of 0.45mm. Its Temperature Coefficient of Resistance is ±100 ppm/°C, and it operates across -55°C to +155°C.
Read more
2. What voltage limits apply when using the RC0603FR-07100KL, and why do they matter?
The RC0603FR-07100KL has a maximum working voltage of 75V and a maximum overload voltage of 150V. These limits are independent of the 1/10W power rating: per YAGEO's rated voltage formula, V = √(P×R) or the max working voltage, whichever is lower — so a high-resistance, low-power design can hit the voltage ceiling before it ever approaches the power ceiling. As a general design consideration, this matters most in high-impedance or high-voltage paths (e.g., some industrial or offline supply circuits); for typical 3.3V/5V logic pull-ups, the resistor operates with wide margin.
Read more
3. Is the RC0603FR-07100KL RoHS compliant and halogen-free?
Yes. The RC0603FR-07100KL is RoHS compliant and halogen-free. It uses lead-free terminations consisting of matte tin over a nickel barrier and has an MSL 1 (Moisture Sensitivity Level 1) rating. The part belongs to YAGEO's RC series of general-purpose thick film chip resistors.
Read more
4. What do the suffix codes in RC0603FR-07100KL mean, and what's the standard order quantity?
In the part number, RC0603 is the chip size, F is the ±1% tolerance code, R is the paper taping reel packaging type, -07 denotes a 7-inch reel, and 100K is the 100kΩ resistance value (L is a default ordering code with no functional meaning). A 7-inch paper tape reel of RC0603 parts ships in quantities of 5,000 pieces per reel.
Read more
5. What should I know about mounting the RC0603FR-07100KL on a PCB?
YAGEO publishes the recommended PCB footprint and soldering profiles in a separate document, "Chip Resistors Mounting," which should be consulted for the recommended land pattern and reflow profile. The RC0603FR-07100KL uses lead-free matte-tin-over-nickel-barrier terminations and is tested in accordance with J-STD-002 Test B1 (solderability/wetting), J-STD-002 Test D (leaching), and MIL-STD-202 Method 210 Condition B for resistance to soldering heat (260°C ±5°C for 10 ±1 seconds immersion).
Read more

Introduction
AI Translation

The TPD2EUSB30, TPD2EUSB30A, and TPD4EUSB30 are 2 and 4 channel Transient Voltage Suppressor (TVS) based Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) protection diode arrays. The TPDxEUSB30/A devices are rated to dissipate ESD strikes at the maximum level specified in the IEC 61000-4-2 international standard (Contact). These devices also offer 5 A (8/20 μs) peak pulse current ratings per IEC 61000-4-5 (Surge) specification. The TPD2EUSB30A offers low 4.5-V DC break-down voltage. The low capacitance, low break-down voltage, and low dynamic resistance make the TPD2EUSB30A a superior protection device for highspeed differential IOs. The TPD2EUSB30 and TPD2EUSB30A are offered in space saving DRT (mm × 1 mm) package. The TPD4EUSB30 is offered in space saving DQA (2.5 mm × 1.0 mm) package.

Introduction
AI Translation

The TPS6293x is an easy-to-use, high-efficiency synchronous buck converter featuring a wide input voltage range of 3.8V to 30V, supporting continuous output currents up to 2A (TPS62932) and 3A (TPS62933 and TPS62933x), with an output voltage range of 0.8V to 22V. The device employs fixed-frequency peak current control mode, enabling fast transient response and excellent line and load regulation. The internal loop compensation is optimized, eliminating the need for external compensation components. The TPS62932, TPS62933, and TPS62933P operate in pulse frequency modulation mode for high light-load efficiency. The TPS62933F operates in forced continuous current modulation mode to maintain low output ripple under all load conditions. The TPS62933O operates in Out-of-Audio mode to avoid audible noise. The ULQ (Ultra-Low Quiescent) feature helps extend battery life. The switching frequency can be set by configuring the RT pin over a range of 200kHz to 2.2MHz, optimizing system efficiency, solution size, and bandwidth. The soft-start time for the TPS62932, TPS62933, and TPS62933F can be adjusted via an external capacitor on the SS pin. The TPS62932, TPS62933, TPS62933P, and TPS62933O feature spread-spectrum frequency modulation to help reduce EMI noise. The TPS6293x is available in a compact SOT583 (1.6mm×2.1mm) package with 0.5mm pin pitch, featuring an optimized pin arrangement to simplify PCB layout and provide good EMI performance.

Introduction
AI Translation

The AP7361C is a 1A, adjustable and fixed output voltage, ultra-low dropout linear regulator with enable. The device includes pass element, error amplifier, band-gap reference, current limit and thermal shutdown circuitry. The device is turned on when EN pin is set to logic high level. The characteristics of the low dropout voltage and low quiescent current make it suitable for low-to-medium power applications; for example, laptop computers, audio and video applications, and battery-powered devices. The typical quiescent current is approximately 60μA. Built-in current-limit and thermal-shutdown functions prevent IC from damage in fault conditions. The AP7361C is available in U-DFN3030-8 (Type E), SOT89-5, SOT223, TO252 (DPAK) and SO-8EP packages.

Introduction
AI Translation

The TCA9517 is a bidirectional buffer with level shifting capabilities for I²C and SMBus systems. It provides bidirectional voltage-level translation (uptranslation/down-translation) between low voltages (down to 0.9 V) and higher voltages (2.7 V to 5.5 V) in mixed-mode applications. This device enables I²C and SMBus systems to be extended without degradation of performance, even during level shifting.

The TCA9517 buffers both the serial data (SDA) and the serial clock (SCL) signals on the I²C bus, thus allowing two buses of up to 400-pF bus capacitance to be connected in an I²C application.

The TCA9517 has two types of drivers: A-side drivers and B-side drivers. All inputs and I/Os are overvoltage tolerant to 5.5 V, even when the device is unpowered (VCCB and/or VCCA = 0 V).

The type of buffer design on the B-side prevents it from being used in series with devices which use static voltage offset. This is because these devices do not recognize buffered low signals as a valid low and do not propagate it as a buffered low again.

The B-side drivers operate from 2.7 V to 5.5 V. The output low level for this internal buffer is approximately 0.5 V but the input voltage must be 70 mV or more below the output low level when the output internally is driven low. The higher-voltage low signal is called a buffered low. When the B-side I/O is driven low internally, the low is not recognized as a low by the input. This feature prevents a lockup condition from occurring when the input low condition is released.

The A-side drivers operate from 0.9 V to 5.5 V and drive more current. They do not require the buffered low feature (or the static offset voltage). This means that a low signal on the B-side translates to a nearly 0 V low on the A-side, which accommodates smaller voltage swings of lower-voltage logic. The output pulldown on the A-side drives a hard low, and the input level is set at 0.3 x VCCA to accommodate the need for a lower low level in systems where the low-voltage-side supply voltage is as low as 0.9 V.

The A-side of two or more TCA9517s can be connected together, allowing many topographies, with the A-side as the common bus. Also, the A-side can be connected directly to any other buffer with static- or dynamic-offset voltage. Multiple TCA9517s can be connected in series, A-side to B-side, with no buildup in offset voltage and with only time-of-flight delays to consider.

Introduction
AI Translation

The LM74700-Q1 is an ideal diode controller compliant with the automotive AEC Q100 standard. It works in conjunction with an external N-channel MOSFET and can function as an ideal diode rectifier to achieve low-loss reverse protection with a 20mV forward voltage drop. The wide power supply input range of 3.2V to 65V enables control of many commonly used DC bus voltages (e.g., 12V, 24V, and 48V automotive battery systems). The 3.2V input voltage support meets the stringent cold-start requirements in automotive systems. The device can withstand negative supply voltages as low as –65V and provides load protection. The device regulates the forward voltage drop to 20mV by controlling the gate of the MOSFET. This current regulation scheme supports smooth shutdown during reverse current events and ensures zero DC reverse current. The device can respond rapidly (<0.75µs) to reverse current blocking, making it suitable for systems that require maintaining the output voltage during ISO7637 pulse tests, power failures, and input micro-short circuit conditions. The LM74700-Q1 controller provides a charge pump gate driver for the external N-channel MOSFET. The high voltage rating of the LM74700-Q1 helps simplify the system design for automotive ISO7637 protection. When the enable pin is at a low level, the controller turns off and consumes approximately 1µA of current.

Features
AI Translation
AEC-Q100 qualified with the following characteristics:
Device temperature grade 1: –40°C to +125°C ambient operating temperature range
Device HBM ESD classification level 2
Device CDM ESD classification level C4B
Functional Safety enabled
3.2V to 65V input range (3.9V startup)
–65V reverse voltage rating
Charge pump for external N-channel MOSFET
20mV anode-to-cathode forward voltage drop regulation
Enable pin feature
1µA shutdown current (EN = low)
80µA operating quiescent current (EN = high)
2.3A peak gate turn-off current
Fast reverse current blocking response: less than 0.75µs
Automotive ISO7637 transient compliant with suitable TVS diode
6-pin and 8-pin SOT-23 package 2.90mm×1.60mm
Applications
AI Translation
Automotive ADAS systems - cameras
Automotive infotainment systems - digital instrument clusters, head units
Industrial factory automation - PLC
Enterprise power supplies
Active ORing for redundant power supplies
